Computer-free authorization
Use this phone’s wireless debugging to authorize MiDuo navigation settings. No computer or separate Shizuku app required.

1. Enable Developer options and connect to Wi-Fi.\n2. Open Wireless debugging, turn it on, then choose Pair device with pairing code.\n3. Keep the system pairing dialog open. Tap the MiDuo Pair bubble and enter its 6-digit code. Ports are discovered automatically or can be entered manually.

Loopback only. Grants only MiDuo WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS. Does not read screens, files or other apps. Pairing codes are never saved or uploaded. Close to cancel; hold the bubble to dismiss. It expires after 10 minutes.
Activate your MiDuo license, select MiDuo as default Home, and enable its accessibility service first.
Enter the pairing port and exactly 6 digits. The pairing port and connection port are different.
Enter the connection port from the Wireless debugging main page, not the pairing dialog.
Open Settings → Additional settings → Developer options → Wireless debugging. Enable Developer options first if needed.
Pairing locally and verifying permission (up to 45 seconds)…
Paired. Find the connection port on the Wireless debugging main page, enter it and tap Already paired: connect and authorize.
Verified: navigation settings permission granted. Enable gestures, then test Back, Home and Recents. Hold the bottom edge for 2 seconds to open recovery.

Paired, but permission was denied. On Xiaomi, check USB debugging (Security settings) in Developer options and follow system confirmation steps before retrying. MiDuo cannot bypass system restrictions.

Authorization did not complete. Check wireless debugging, keep the pairing dialog open, use a fresh code, and verify both ports. If the system requires security settings, follow its instructions before retrying.
The pairing component could not load on this system. Navigation mode was not changed. Keep system navigation buttons and report the device model.
